subject: getting tick labels to fit in grid.arrange

messages.author: 7a2c097f8b936c87
messages.subject: getting tick labels to fit in grid.arrange
parts:
Hi Folks,

I've set up the plot below (and here: http://i.imgur.com/vScUR31.png) using the following code:

    require(gridExtra)
    plot_grobs = ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(mort_by_2))$grobs
    grid.arrange(mort_by_2_nolab, mort_by_3_nolab,
                 mort_by_4_nolab, mort_by_5_nolab, plot_grobs[[5]], ncol=1,
                 left = "Proportion of trees dead")

As you can see, the tick labels on the bottom are going to the edges of the entire plot, and hence they don't line up properly.  Any idea how I might constrain them to the plot area so the fit correctly?

Thanks,
Allie

messages.author: 7a2c097f8b936c87
messages.subject: Re: getting tick labels to fit in grid.arrange
parts:
Hi Brandon,

Tweaking with the heights isn't ideal, since if my labels change for
example, i'll have to re-tweak the heights all over again. Might be a
good last resort.

Here's some reproducible code that leads to the plot seen here:
http://i.imgur.com/okbwX55.png

Any thoughts about how to get the tick labels aligned?

thanks.

groups = c("grp1","grp2","grp3")
my_df = data.frame(group = sample(groups,100,replace=T), surv1 =
sample(c(1,0),100,replace=T), surv2 = sample(c(1,0),100,replace=T))
my_df_summ =
ddply(my_df, "group", summarize, surv_rate1 = mean(surv1), num_surv1
= sum(surv1),
surv_rate2 = mean(surv2), num_surv2 =
sum(surv2),
n = length(surv1))
require(binom)
attach(my_df_summ)
limits1 = binom.confint(num_surv1, n, method="exact")
limits2 = binom.confint(num_surv2, n, method="exact")
detach(my_df_summ)

ggsurv1 = ggplot(my_df_summ, aes(x=group, y=surv_rate1)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity") +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = limits1$upper, ymin = limits1$lower),
position = "dodge", width = 0.25, col="darkgrey")
ggsurv2 = ggplot(my_df_summ, aes(x=group, y=surv_rate2)) +
geom_bar(stat="identity") +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = limits2$upper, ymin = limits2$lower),
position = "dodge", width = 0.25, col="darkgrey")

plot_grobs = ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(ggsurv1 + ylab("")))$grobs

require(gridExtra)
grid.arrange(ggsurv1 + scale_x_discrete(labels="") + xlab("") + ylab(""),
ggsurv2+ scale_x_discrete(labels="") + xlab("") + ylab(""),
plot_grobs[[5]], ncol=1,
left = "Proportion alive")
